name: Do general contractor services include handling building permits and inspections?

mainEntity.name: Do general contractor services include handling building permits and inspections?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most residential remodels that alter structural walls, relocate plumbing lines, modify electrical circuits, or build room additions require building permits from your local city or county building department. Routine finish repairs, cosmetic drywall patches, replacing existing floor tile, and interior repainting typically do not need permits. When permits are mandated, an experienced contractor coordinates with the local jurisdiction, submits plans, and schedules mandatory rough-in and final inspections alongside licensed trade partners.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, major projects altering framing, plumbing, or electrical work require permits and inspections, which the contractor plans and schedules with local authorities.
